game.name: Stellar Drift
game.description: Dodge cosmic debris, collect star shards, and survive the neon void.

generation.author: Yingrjimsch
generation.prompt: Create a self-contained, mobile-friendly HTML5 arcade game named Stellar Drift. The player steers a small ship through a neon starfield, dodges falling meteors, and collects glowing star shards for bonus points. Use only HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript with no external dependencies. Include keyboard and pointer controls, a score, a persistent local best score, and a replay flow.
